scope: A derived SQLite subset (disease mutations, polymorphisms, GenBank counts, literature references, loci) of the MITOMAP daily PostgreSQL dump. Submitter contact tables are excluded. Values are served unmodified apart from reshaping.
interpretation: The repository owner's own determination that redistributing this derived, attributed research-use snapshot is permitted under CC BY 3.0. This is not an approval by MITOMAP or the Children's Hospital of Philadelphia, and not a legal opinion.
disclaimer: Research use only; not clinical decision support. MITOMAP status ('Reported', 'Cfrm', ...) is a report of published literature, not an assignment of pathogenicity.
